primary_claim: A single linear feature in the residual stream of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B (isolated at layer 20) causally mediates error-detection behaviour in chain-of-thought reasoning: patching just the projection along this direction recovers most of the logit-diff between clean and corrupted CoTs, clamping it induces or suppresses self-correction, and the feature sometimes fires on errors even when the CoT never acknowledges the mistake.

effect.metric: fraction of logit-diff recovered by activation patching along the found direction
effect.value: patching just the projection along the direction recaptures most of the logit-diff between corrupted and clean residual streams (majority of the effect of full-layer patching)

contradicts_or_qualifies: relates to evidence that CoT is often unfaithful and that optimizing CoTs against unwanted behaviour tends to obfuscate rather than remove it (arXiv:2503.11926); finding the feature fires even without CoT acknowledgment adds an interesting datapoint on CoT faithfulness
stated_future_work: investigate effectiveness of probes for a behaviour (e.g. reward-hacking) before and after RL-optimizing CoTs against that behaviour, to see if probes still perform well when CoT is obfuscated
determine if this feature is truly 1D or better captured by a higher-dimensional subspace
investigate what happens downstream of this feature, e.g. whether it acts primarily through the gate_proj of subsequent MLPs
determine the 'context range' of the behaviour, i.e. how the feature activation delta attenuates after an error
stress-test precision and recall of the feature as a general error detector
limitations_stated: the synthetic dataset's arbitrary token-editing while freezing subsequent tokens may causally screen off effects, limiting its use for studying error-detection vs. error-correction dynamics
the data-generating process is hacky; only about 44% of ~49,000 generated clean/corrupted pairs passed the logit-diff filtering threshold
didn't do enough due diligence on whether the feature is truly 1D or a higher-dimensional subspace
precision and recall of the feature as a general error detector were not rigorously tested
author's confidence in a strong Linear Representation Hypothesis has waned, motivating skepticism that a simple linear direction fully captures the phenomenon
quote: I find strong evidence that error-detection behaviour in is mediated by a linear feature in the model’s residual stream.
